signals.title: Puppet Show: "Thumbelina" (Палечка)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, ul. Hristo G. Danov 14, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Hans Christian Andersen's classic fairy tale adapted specifically for preschoolers in an intimate, high-quality puppet staging.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Kose Bose" (Косе Босе)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, ul. Hristo G. Danov 14, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Beloved traditional Bulgarian animal fable about the quick-witted blackbird and the fox, ideal for young attention spans.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "The Enormous Turnip" (Дядо вади ряпа)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, ul. General Gurko 46, Stara Zagora
signals.reason: Lively, physical harvest folk tale that toddlers can follow easily, situated an hour's drive away and easy to pair with Stara Zagora Zoo.

signals.title: Family Ballet: "The Son of the Monkeys" (Синът на маймуните)
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A bright, accessible children's ballet telling the Tarzan story with animal dancers, though the 19:00 evening start requires an earlier afternoon nap.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "The Iron Boy" (Желязното момче)
signals.reason: Morning puppet production 35 minutes away that pairs smoothly with an afternoon spent exploring Pazardzhik's Island Park playgrounds.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Grandpa's Mitten" (Дядовата ръкавичка)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, ul. Hristo G. Danov 14, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Warm, engaging woodland animal folklore staging specifically created for children aged 3 and up.
signals.note: Not scheduled for November 8, 2026; official schedule at pptheatre.com lists Chuk i Puk instead.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.location: Aviation Museum, Plovdiv Airport grounds, Krumovo (~15 min drive)
signals.reason: Spacious open-air airfield displaying dozens of vintage planes and helicopters where a preschooler can freely run, explore, and touch real aircraft.

signals.title: Damascena Biopark & Rose Valley Gardens
signals.reason: Paved stroller-friendly garden paths, sculptures, running fountains, and enclosed habitats with deer, swans, and ostriches.

signals.title: Road closures in Central Plovdiv for presidential election runoff logistics
signals.location: Ulitsa Hristo G. Danov (between ul. Beethoven and bul. Ruski), ul. Dr. Nikola Genadiev, and ul. Knyaz Aleksandar Ekzarh, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Direct vehicular shutdown on key central residential streets immediately adjacent to the Central District administration for ballot logistics.

signals.title: EVN Toplofikatsiya begins seasonal district central heating roll-out
signals.reason: Crucial seasonal utility action: residents must open radiator valves fully to purge air traps and check heat meters to prevent incorrect billing.
signals.note: Confirmed on bnr.bg Radio Plovdiv and plovdiv24.bg.

signals.title: Ryanair launches new direct scheduled route connecting Plovdiv and Malta
signals.when_text: Announced this week (tickets on sale now; flights operate Summer 2027)
signals.reason: Durable practical route expansion offering direct twice-weekly Mediterranean flights directly out of Plovdiv Airport without driving to Sofia.

signals.title: Match-day traffic alert: Lokomotiv Plovdiv vs. Ludogorets Razgrad
signals.location: Stadion Lokomotiv (Lauta Park), Trakia District, Plovdiv
signals.reason: High-profile league fixture expected to trigger heavy transit congestion and police cordons across south-eastern Plovdiv and surrounding boulevards.

signals.title: Southern Bypass Collector sewer construction and long-term street closures
signals.location: Bulevard Aleksandar Stamboliyski and Kuklensko Shose, Kyuchuk Parizh, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major utility trenching cutting key transit routes across southern Plovdiv with active detours affecting municipal bus lines 1, 16, and 36.

signals.title: Plovdiv officially designated European Capital of Sport for 2028
signals.reason: Durable civic milestone confirmed by ACES Europe, unlocking multi-year municipal investments in sporting facilities and public recreation grounds.

signals.title: Symphony Concert: 'The Czech Romantics' (Чешките романтици)
signals.location: Dom na Kulturata 'Boris Hristov', Ulitsa William Gladstone 15, Plovdiv
signals.reason: An orchestral performance of major symphonic works by Dvořák and Smetana by the State Opera Symphony Orchestra; purely instrumental so language is no barrier.

signals.title: Svetlin Roussev: 50 Years of Excellence Anniversary Concert
signals.location: Plovdiv Hall, SPS Hotel, Bulevard Osvobozhdenie 3, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Renowned virtuoso violinist performing a milestone classical repertoire; fully musical and instrumental with zero language barrier.

signals.title: Farmers Market at Ribnitsa Park
signals.reason: An established open-air weekend food market focusing on regional Thracian agricultural produce, artisanal breads, and honey; fully accessible and browseable without Bulgarian.

signals.title: Sunset Viewpoint at Bunardzhik Hill
signals.reason: A direct, quiet walk right out of central Plovdiv offering 360-degree panoramic views over the city and the Rhodope range without tickets, bookings, or language friction.
